subject: Copy of Newspaper Publication
detail: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of extract of the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

subject: Dividend
detail: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 26, 2026, declared 2nd Interim Dividend for the FY 2026-27 of Rs. 1.25 per equity share.

subject: Record Date
detail: Patanjali Foods Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of 2nd Interim Dividend for the F.Y. 26-27 is December 11, 2026.
